lastCompletedStory.title: Fold the deterministic preflight into `cam next` as a signal-write gate

nextStoryContext: `cam next` now runs a deterministic preflight (src/commands/next-preflight.ts, runNextPreflight) as a gate on the active:true signal write, folding in what used to be the imperative 'Pre-flight Checks' section of cam-next.md (both templates/ and .claude/ dual copies, edited in the same commit): git fetch origin -> resolve current branch (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD, unless overridden) -> sync with remote (git rev-parse --verify origin/<branch>: exists -> git pull origin <branch>, absent -> git push -u origin <branch> to create the tracking branch) -> git status --porcelain clean-tree check -> bun run typecheck -> bun test. Every step is a discriminated union { ok: true } | { ok: false; step; detail }, first-failing-step halts (no later step runs), reusing combineStreams + the PlanPreflightSpawnFn shape from src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts (aliased NextPreflightSpawnFn) rather than duplicating them. Wired into runNext (src/commands/next.ts) via two new NextOptions fields: skipPreflight?: boolean (the --skip-preflight CLI flag, the resume escape -- bypasses the gate entirely, preflightFn is never called) and preflightFn?: () => NextPreflightResult (defaults to a real spawnSync-backed closure built from the spawnSync already dynamically imported in runNext for tmux calls). Gate placement: after the existing sidecarLivenessGate check, before the active:true write block. index.ts: parseNextArgs gained skipPreflight (via --skip-preflight, no value), threaded into the runNext call at the 'next' case; NEXT_HELP got a matching Options entry. CRITICAL gotcha for the next story that touches runNext or its call sites: every runNext(...) test call across the WHOLE test/ tree that reaches past the sidecar-liveness gate must inject a preflightFn fake (or skipPreflight: true) -- otherwise it falls through to the real default and either shells out to real git in a tmpdir with no repo (fails at git-fetch) or -- if it somehow got further -- would recurse bun test inside bun test. This story already fixed the two pre-existing files affected (test/next.test.ts: 7 call sites; test/attach-hint.test.ts: 2 call sites); grep `runNext({` repo-wide before adding new tests. embed-vendor: templates/commands/cam-next.md is embedded generically by scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts's walkFiles (no filter, unlike the curated vendor/ FILES list), so any templates/ edit requires `bun run embed-vendor` (regenerates src/vendor/_generated.ts) before `bun run embed-vendor:check` / test/embedded.test.ts's byte-parity test will pass -- this file is NOT part of the curated FILES const, it rides the generic templates/ walk.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed --verify exits non-zero (fatal error, or silent with -q) when the given ref (e.g. origin/<branch>) does not resolve to a valid object -- exactly the signal runNextPreflight's syncWithRemote helper uses to decide pull-vs-push -u.
